author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices three-finger patterns, counting to four, walking and running notes, and the song's repeating shape, with an old London street cry.

classes.title: Find your three-key house
classes.goal: Find C by its landmark and rest three fingers on C, D and E.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the two black keys to find where the hand lives

classes.parentPrompt: Point to the two black keys, then help your child rest the thumb on C, just left.
classes.childAction: Thumb on C, then fingers 2 and 3 on D and E.
classes.bridge: The two black keys are a roof; your three fingers live in the house below.

intro.caption: Find the two black keys
intro.parentCue: help the thumb land just left of them, on C

games.caption: One finger, one key
games.parentCue: Say 'one, two, three' with each finger

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding the hand's place by a landmark.

classes.title: Three, two, one, home
classes.goal: Play 'hot cross buns' as fingers 3, 2, 1 walking down to C.

mathTarget.parentLine: Counting backward: three, two, one, home

classes.parentPrompt: Say the finger numbers aloud, 'three, two, one', and tap each finger gently first.
classes.childAction: Play fingers 3, 2, 1: E, D, C, down the stairs.
classes.bridge: Three little stairs going down to the front door, C.

intro.caption: Three, two, one, home
intro.parentCue: say the finger numbers aloud together

games.caption: Hot cross buns: 3, 2, 1
games.parentCue: Tap fingers 3, 2, 1 on your child's hand first

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing three fingers in order.

classes.title: How many hot cross buns?
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and count how many times 'hot cross buns' comes.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same line comes three times, with one new line

classes.parentPrompt: Each time 'hot cross buns' comes, hold up one more finger: one, two, three.
classes.childAction: Play the song and count the 'hot cross buns' lines on your fingers.
classes.bridge: 'Hot cross buns' is a friend who knocks three times; the pennies visit once.

intro.caption: How many times? Let's count
intro.parentCue: hold up one finger each time the line comes

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: counting how often a line repeats.

classes.title: Run-ning pennies
classes.goal: Play the quick 'one a penny' part slowly: four quick notes on C, four on D.

mathTarget.parentLine: Quick notes come two for every one walking step

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'walk' for the slow notes and 'run-ning' for the quick ones while your child plays.
classes.childAction: Play four quick C's, then four quick D's. Count to four.
classes.bridge: Walking notes are big steps; run-ning notes are two tiny mouse steps per beat.

intro.caption: Walk, walk, run-ning, run-ning
intro.parentCue: say the words slowly as your child plays

games.caption: Four on C, four on D
games.parentCue: Count 'one, two, three, four' for each group

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: counting to four and playing quick notes.

classes.title: Four beats, slow and even
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly while counting four beats in every bar.

mathTarget.parentLine: Each bar holds four even beats

classes.parentPrompt: Tap your child's shoulder on each beat and count 1, 2, 3, 4 softly.
classes.childAction: Play slowly while your grown-up counts to four.
classes.bridge: Each bar is a tray holding four buns: one, two, three, four.

intro.caption: Slow and even wins
intro.parentCue: tap your child's shoulder and count to four

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing slowly and evenly in fours.

classes.title: Same song, upstairs
classes.goal: Play the same song with the same fingers on a higher C.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same pattern moved to a new place sounds higher

classes.parentPrompt: Show your child the next two black keys to the right; help the thumb find that C.
classes.childAction: Move your hand up to the next C and play the song again.
classes.bridge: Higher C is the same house, upstairs: same fingers, brighter sound.

intro.caption: Same song, new house
intro.parentCue: ask your child: which one sounds nicer?

games.caption: Upstairs: E, D, C
games.parentCue: Help the thumb find the higher C

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing the same song in a new place.

classes.title: Keep up with the music
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music at full speed.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping up with a beat that does not wait

classes.parentPrompt: Nod on each beat and keep playing your part; if a note slips, keep going.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music and keep going, even after a slip.
classes.bridge: The music is a moving cart; hop on and ride, even past bumps.

intro.caption: Hop on and keep going
intro.parentCue: nod the beat and smile at slips

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping up with the music together.

classes.title: Call like a street seller
classes.goal: Sing the words while playing, like the sellers who called them in old London.

mathTarget.parentLine: Each sung word matches one key press

classes.parentPrompt: Sing first in a big, clear calling voice; then sing along while your child plays.
classes.childAction: Sing the words and play one key for each word.
classes.bridge: Long ago, sellers called this in the street: one word, one key.

intro.caption: Sing it like a call
intro.parentCue: sing out clearly first, then sing along

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: singing and playing at the same time.

classes.title: Bun concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy from start to end, then bow together.

mathTarget.parentLine: A song starts, goes on and ends; we finish together

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; announce the song, then clap and bow together at the end.
classes.childAction: Announce your song, play it for teddy, then take a bow.
classes.bridge: Start loud and proud, land softly home on C, then bow.

intro.caption: Concert time for teddy!
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.
